item_title: Terra Verde data center: EIR certification and site development permit
text:
Dear Councilmember,

I live in Alviso and I am strongly OPPOSED to the proposed Terra Verde data center off Gold Street. Alviso already sits below sea level and floods — the last thing we need is acres of concrete and a facility drawing millions of gallons for cooling. Who gets the water when there's a drought, us or the servers?

This belongs nowhere near a flood-prone residential community. Please vote no.

[name removed]
subject: Strongly oppose the Terra Verde data center

item_title: Terra Verde data center: EIR certification and site development permit
text: I know everyone's mad but honestly I SUPPORT the Terra Verde project. North San Jose has empty industrial lots doing nothing. Construction jobs, tax base, and it's an industrial zone — not someone's backyard. We can't say no to everything and then complain about the budget. Build it.
subject: data center = more jobs, I support it

item_title: Terra Verde data center: EIR certification and site development permit
text:
Dear Councilmember,

I am a hydrologist and an Alviso resident. I'm not reflexively anti-development, but the Terra Verde EIR appears to understate groundwater and cooling-water demand and does not adequately model cumulative flood impacts. I OPPOSE certification of the EIR as written and request an independent peer review before any vote.

I'm happy to provide technical comments. Thank you.

[name removed], PhD
subject: Request for independent environmental review — Terra Verde

item_title: Terra Verde data center: EIR certification and site development permit
text: I'm genuinely torn. We need the tax revenue and the land is industrial. But I also worry about water and traffic on Zanker. I guess I'd support it IF there were strong water-recycling requirements and a community benefit agreement. Without those I lean no. Just sharing honestly.
subject: mixed feelings on Terra Verde

item_title: Terra Verde data center: EIR certification and site development permit

I'd ask the city to attach reasonable conditions on water recycling, but on balance this is good for San Jose's economy. Please approve it.

Regards,

subject: Support Terra Verde with conditions

text:
